pr_title: [FontData] Fixes saving copy of the font source data, if it was created from built-in font.
pr_body: Fixes #53253 (theme in the extension should be reimported to work).

issue_context.title: Wrong glyphs rendered in Label with custom theme derived from editor theme
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

v4.0.dev.custom_build [5489f4384]

confirmed in v4.0.dev.custom_build [ac7505e27]

### System information

manjaro 21, AMD Radeon r7 200 series, Vulkan, 8GB Memory

### Issue description

After opening a project with a addon, the text was all messed:
![Peek 2021-09-30 07-55](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/58845030/135443040-be331b5d-6f0d-4adb-ba27-5991b64e90c7.gif)




### Steps to reproduce

* Open Project
* Open Addon Scene

### Minimal reproduction project

this is an addon, so in order to install:
* Create a new project
* Create an addon folder
* inside use the command bellow
`git clone git@github.com:nonunknown/gdextension-integration.git`
comments: How do you build Godot? Do you disable the `text_server_adv` module and use the fallback one instead? In which case this could be what #53221 fixed and you're just on an older (9 days old) commit.

can confirm in the most recent commit:

v4.0.dev.custom_build [ac7505e27]

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/58845030/135465307-211d3c3a-354a-41f1-8a86-32c97b83401e.png)

I can reproduce the issue, here's a MRP with the above extension properly set up:
[Test Project.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/7260063/Test.Project.zip)

No idea what causes it but it seems to be specific to what this extension does. The scene has a tool script which might mess with stuff, but I don't see any obvious issue. CC @bruvzg @Paulb23
Seems to be related to the `Theme` used, probably importing editor theme to the custom one do something wrong with the fonts.

Editor fonts are loaded from memory instead of files and `FontData` copy saved to the custom theme seems to be missing source `ttf` file data (only have cached glyphs which were rendered at the time of theme import, and without it Font can't convert char codes to glyph indices).
Yeah makes sense, I've imported the default editor theme and modified it!

review_comments: If feels weird that this could happen and be handled in the getter specifically. Shouldn't it be properly matching if `set_data()` was called?
It could be handled in the `set_data_ptr`, but then it will create extra copy of all editor fonts every time (more than 10 MB of wasted memory), this way `PackedByteArray` copy is created on demand.
